name: dev-servers
description: Fleet visibility for hosts running the Quox dev-mode agent. See every registered dev server, its profile-verification status, and which dev-suite capabilities (register, build, clarify, gripe, docs) each host has enabled versus available. Read-only inventory today; per-capability panels (build queue, clarify, gripes, docs) land as member plugins ship.
shortDescription: Registered dev-server inventory with per-host capability visibility.
author: QUOX
marketingPoints: Every registered dev server in one panel
Per-host capability pills: register, build, clarify, gripe, docs
Read-only today, capability panels roll in per member plugin

fleetInventory.name: Dev Server Inventory
fleetInventory.description: See every host that has enabled the dev-mode agent profile, sourced from the durable dev_servers registry.

profileVerification.name: Profile Verification
profileVerification.description: Each host shows whether its signed dev-mode capability profile has been verified.

capabilityPills.name: Capability Visibility
capabilityPills.description: Enabled vs. known dev-suite capabilities (dev.register, dev.build, dev.clarify, dev.gripe, dev.docs) per host.

requirements.external: quoxagent dev-mode capability profile (dev.register) enabled on the host

notes.important: Phase 1 of DEVSUITE-HUB: read-only inventory grid only. No build queue, live log stream, or terminal in this pass — those are DEVSUITE-BUILD's per-capability panels, layered on later. See docs/STREAM_DEVSUITE_HUB_PLAN.md.
